`WithComment.rar` is a 288-byte test fixture from [node-unrar.js](https://github.com/YuJianrong/node-unrar.js/blob/master/testFiles/WithComment.rar), copyright Yu Jianrong, MIT license. It contains two empty text files, including one Chinese filename. It is used only by tests and is not included in the desktop distribution.

`role-{chiori,ganyu,aodaita}-{left,right}.png` are small role-name crops from the three 1920×1080 Genshin screenshots supplied by the user for the 2026-09-28 recognition regression. They contain only the top-left title / right-side name, not the full screenshot or UID. `*-title.png` are the right-hand crops after `prepareRoleTitle` preprocessing, for the Node OCR tests. The Electron overlay smoke reprocesses the original right-hand crops with NativeImage and runs real OCR, so the preprocessing pipeline is also exercised. These fixtures are not shipped in the desktop distribution.
